title: Typical student errors in school maths: misconception codes with teacher labels in 7 languages
description: 935 codes of typical student errors in school mathematics (lost carry, added denominators, wrong angle sum, fencepost error and others), each with a short teacher-facing label in English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Dutch, linked to the school maths skills where the error is modelled in multiple-choice distractors. Skill identifiers match the Imaginesis curriculum crosswalk, prerequisite graph and skill names datasets. Not a frequency study. Prepared by Imaginesis (https://imaginesis.com), a maths word-problem worksheet generator.
